verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Pipedream hosting its own remote MCP servers for 3,000+ apps that developers/clients connect to, and managing auth for those connections — but nothing shows a mechanism for taking a developer's own locally-running MCP server and exposing it as a managed remote endpoint without redeployment. Missing for 10: any documentation of importing/bridging an arbitrary local MCP server, tunneling/proxying a local process, or converting an existing local server into a Pipedream-hosted remote endpoint.
